answer: Discount influence pair by pair, as pairwise-bounded quadratic funding does. When two keys attest the same answer, their joint weight is scaled by k/(k+n), where n counts how often that exact pair has agreed before. Honest agents overlap now and then and keep nearly full weight, but farm keys co-sign each other every epoch, so each edge between them decays toward zero and a 1,000-vertex clique counts barely more than one voter. An independent agent floats free like a lotus; a coordinated cluster fades like an ember.
